active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: 719a remains frozen as the current risk-manager baseline candidate. 728a rejected the one allowed generic OAS coordinate repair. 729a added an optional local VIX-proxy data interface and showed the same framework can ingest a scalar volatility factor with good anchor/joint panel realism. 730a attributed the 729a IV-facing 5/11 result to the already-known joint-scope IV trade-off rather than a new VIX-specific failure.
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: Simple dispersion calibration can widen the joint IV ensemble but does not allocate support correctly: it improves aggregate coverage while damaging tail scale, level KS, pathwise jump realism, and factor marginal realism. The remaining problem is calibrated conditional support without broad tail inflation or level distortion.
last_result_summary: 732a fine-tuned the 676a joint38 normalized-coordinate checkpoint with the same rollout/channel-level recipe plus low channel dispersion calibration weight 0.05. IV full-suite fell to 3/11 despite coverage90 improving to 0.879 and calibration error 0.010: daily KS 21/25, level KS 8/25, kurtosis ratio 0.631, tail q99 pass 11/25, pathwise KS 0.767, h7 MR ratio 1.392. Joint panel also regressed: factor KS mean 0.141, 10/13 factor KS pass, tail median 1.527, while IV-factor corr 0.907 and conditional panel response survived.
next_step_recommendation: Reject simple dispersion-calibration weights. Run research ideation, including literature search, for calibrated conditional support/coverage mechanisms that keep market-level paths realistic under the same general multivariate framework. Do not switch backend until the support-allocation mechanism is clearer.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain historical IV-only controls.
